budgets.qualification: Per-test and UI budgets are unchanged. Parent monotonic clocks are outside child Date mocks. Outer135s deadline permits only bounded4s failure cleanup; no later phase after timeout. Full raw output is retained; exceeding bound fails, without truncating to manufacture pass. Synchronous filesystem calls are not kernel-preempted by the timer; monotonic elapsed checks refuse a late PASS. The60s phase bound covers original child close/EOF observation; outer135s covers remaining control work before final admission. The absolute monotonic outer cutoff is checked synchronously immediately before scope creation, every source materialization, RED-to-GREEN transition, fixed-controls open/write, and every child spawn; a pending timer callback cannot admit a later phase. Cleanup stores one original start/deadline on the original active process; exceptional reentry uses only its remaining interval and never replays a TERM/KILL attempt.

limitations: Synchronous filesystem/proc operations and current in-flight writes are not kernel-preempted by JavaScript timers. Explicit monotonic admission checks prevent knowingly starting subsequent admitted work after the original outer deadline; final elapsed checks refuse a late PASS.

Cleanup polling/signal actions use one original interval; synchronous final diagnostic I/O can outlive a timer tick. No claim of hard OS-level process cancellation or continuous executable custody is made.
